predictions.selection_reason: curve structure -> mpz_clears with NULL argument -> fails to clear mpz_t fields, causing memory leak and possibly leaving sensitive data in memory
predictions.source_summary: Curve structure containing four mpz_t fields (p, a, b, q) initialized in buildCurve function
predictions.sink_summary: mpz_clears function call with NULL argument instead of the actual mpz_t fields
predictions.guard_summary: No validation or proper cleanup of mpz_t fields before freeing the Curve structure

predictions.context_summary: destroyCurve function intended to clean up Curve structure with four mpz_t fields, but incorrectly passes NULL to mpz_clears instead of the actual field references
